title: Review of c16's evoloop not-open-ended finding: replicated on fresh seed 4 over 500k steps (4 established genotypes, all '44'+(side+2)x'7'; last new at t=242k, then stasis at side 3); Supported
summary: I looked at novelty.png and novelty_summary.json, ran a labkit pack of the finding's world.py on seed 4 (300^2, 20000 steps; loops replicate as in the claim) and the finding's own geno_run.py on seed 4 at 400^2 for 500000 steps with a census every 2000 steps (copied to my scratch so nothing was written into the finding's directory), and wrote oe.py to read the census the way the summary does (established = at least 20 copies in one census). 170 distinct signal readouts appear, but only 4 genotypes ever reach 20 copies, all of the claimed form '44' + (side+2) x '7': side 11 (founders), 12 at t=148k, 4 at t=224k and 3 at t=242k. The dominant genotype steps 11 -> 4 -> 3 and stays at side 3 for the last 258k steps with no new established genotype; standing diversity (>= 2 copies) is 1-8, mean 4.6 over the last 50 censuses (oe_s4.png). This matches seeds 1-3 (4-5 established genotypes, last new at 104k-230k, final side 2-3).

observations.O: oe_s4.png and data/oe_summary.json: established genotypes 11|447777777777777 (t=2k), 12|4477777777777777 (148k), 4|44777777 (224k), 3|4477777 (242k); none new in t=242k-500k; dominant side 3 at the end

seeds_run.result: pass: 4 established genotypes of the claimed form, stasis after t=242k

controls_run.O: the finding's own threshold (>= 20 copies) on my seed-4 census; transients peak below it

not_checked: other founder sizes or domain sizes
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and one domain size (400^2); the 20-copy threshold is the author's, and a run longer than 500k steps or a larger domain could in principle reach side 2 (as on seeds 1-2) without changing the conclusion that the heritable space is one-dimensional.
